name: USG LAX shuttle
details: usg has run a shuttle between lax and campus around breaks. i couldn't confirm this year's dates or price, so i'd check with usg.

name: USG farmers market
details: the trojan farmers market is on mccarthy quad, put on by usc hospitality. the next ones are wed nov 18 and wed dec 2. usc's two listings disagree on the hours (one says 10am to 2pm, the other 11am to 3pm), so 11am to 2pm is the safe window. ebt works for produce, nuts, eggs and honey.

name: USG thrift
details: usg runs a thrift for students. i don't have confirmed dates or a spot for this year, so i'd check with usg.

name: USG RSO funding
details: recognized student orgs and usc undergrads can apply for usg funding on engagesc. apps are due wednesdays by 11:59pm, six academic weeks before the event (or nine before the first payment is due, whichever comes first), and an rso can get up to 4 events funded a semester as long as it stays under $8,000 from usg a year. the senate was looking at changing the deadline rules in oct 2026, so double check the page before u plan around them.

name: USG Committee on Sustainability and Campus Infrastructure
details: usg's sustainability and campus infrastructure committee covers infrastructure, safety, hospitality and sustainable operations on campus.

name: USG Committee on Affordability and Basic Needs
details: usg's affordability and basic needs committee covers students' financial barriers on campus and access to basic needs.

name: USG Committee on Academic Affairs
details: usg's academic affairs committee covers the academic experience and learning environment for undergrads.

name: USG Committee on External Affairs
details: usg's external affairs committee covers the neighborhood around usc and usc's relationship with la county and local government.

name: USG Committee on Wellness Affairs
details: usg's wellness affairs committee covers student well-being: mental, physical, sexual and spiritual health.

name: USG Committee on Accessibility Affairs
details: usg's accessibility committee covers ada compliance at usc and the needs of students with disabilities.

name: USG Funding Department
details: usg's funding department handles funding applications from student orgs and undergrads.

name: USG general contact
details: usg's general inbox. usg's site says the senate meets tuesdays at 7pm in tcc 450, and each meeting has an open forum where u can bring ideas or concerns.
